name: cusum
comment: Sig: [iupper,ilower,uppersum,lowersum] = cusum(x, climit, mshift, tmean, tdev). Standard one-sided CUSUM with mshift/2 slack on standardized z=(x-tmean)/tdev. Step input [0 0 0 5 5 5 5 5] with climit=2, mshift=1, tmean=0, tdev=1: upper sum first exceeds 2 at sample iu=4 (us(4)=4.5, us(8)=24.5), no lower detection (numel(il)=0). Lifted to public C++ API numkit::signal::cusum (was adapter-only; CusumResult struct, tmean/tdev as Value::Empty=auto) 2026-06.
